steps.content: You manage to beat back some of the beat-up enemies. They are weak but numerous. You can't defeat them all at once. You try hard to sever the contamination clinging to Hamel.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Wake up. Someone is waiting for your return.

steps.content: She doesn't respond.
As you tear away the tentacles on Hamel's arm, more dark substance latches onto you and crushes you so hard that you feel as if all your bones are going to snap.

steps.speaker: Puppets in the Carnival
steps.content: She belongs here, forever and ever! Go to hell!
A split second before you're consumed, Hamel opens her eyes slowly.
...A hush descends. The tentacles of contamination are gone, along with the din. At the lake bottom, where the sun can not reach and time seems to stop, you and Hamel are left alone.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Time starts to flow again... I... remember you...
A warm current courses through your body and washes away all your pain. She looks up into your eyes.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: That black hole in your heart... is it still there?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: It's been filled up. Thank you for bringing my friends back.
Still there. But I can move on now.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Really... That's great...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: The carnival's ended. Let me take you out of here.

steps.content: Hamel makes no response. The bottom of the lake starts shaking violently, and low, agitated voices travel through the water and pound on your eardrums.
...It's the specters!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: They're my audience... They're still here, they need me...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I can't leave the stage...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You don't have to dance for them!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's get out of here. People will come and take care of this. They'll deal with your audience.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Who... and how...?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: My audience stays here just for the show.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You... will you all be able to soothe all the pain, and comfort everyone here?
You're stunned. How... how many Corruptors are here?

Thirty thousand people went missing on the day the Ring appeared, and every year since then, there have been additional missing people. That's a huge number, even after taking into account the Corruptors consumed by the awakened Corpus.
If they're released from this place, will those by the riverside—your Sinners, Nightingale, and the FAC units, be able to resist them?

In the 23 years BR-001 was suppressed by Hamel, the amount of contamination that has leaked out has been enough to pollute the entire Rust. Even if all the troops are mobilized, can they... resist these tens of thousands of monsters that have been under the influence of the Black Ring?

There is no water pressure in the illusory realm, but the low, continuous moaning makes your chest tight nevertheless. The monsters are still here, threatening to break the peace that came not so long ago.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It's okay... I'm happy to dance for them...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: There must be some other way.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've done enough. You don't need to make sacrifices anymore. We're going back together, like I promised. I can't leave you here alone!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Back... I won't be lonely when I'm back?
She raises her hand and rests it on your cheek, her rose-red pupils overflowing with sadness and gentleness. Looking at her, you lose the power of speech.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I'm not afraid of loneliness, never have been... Loneliness follows me wherever I go.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Here, at least I have an audience, and I can dance freely.
The illusory realm starts trembling. The cries of the Corruptors reach you.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Thank you for looking for me... It's all right now... Go back...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Go back to your friends.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: This is the stage I've chosen, it is my home too.
Your word is swallowed up by the waters. Her hand moves from your face to your chest, and gives it a gentle push.

The world is falling away from you. You see a jungle of black hands at the bottom of the lake, see the only spot of light being engulfed by darkness. You try in vain to swim downwards. Inevitably, you are pushed out of the illusory realm. You cry out, but your voice will never reach Hamel.
Hamel is alone at the pitch-black bottom. She rises to her feet slowly, as the stage, a cage made for her, goes up.

steps.speaker: Fear Puppet
steps.content: Don't go... Don't go... Hamel...

steps.speaker: Misery Puppet
steps.content: Dance for us... Lift the curse on us...
She picks up the pendant lodged in the fine sand, looking at it like it's a lost memory. Only after a while does she clutch it in her palm.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Do you hate us...? Are you scared of us...?

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: Because we're monsters, you're leaving us too...?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: No... You're my audience. It's just that you're ahead of others in reaching the end that nobody can escape...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: All of us will be lost and lonely eventually...
Water rolls out from the bottom of the lake, sweeping away all the filth, pain, and darkness. The giant Ferris wheel rises and spins. The last illusory realm has come into being.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Welcome to the last chapter of our joyous music. It ends with the destruction of this world of ours...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Thank you all. When I was lost and lonely, you gave me...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: A stage whose curtain never comes down.
She raises her arms, the hem of her dress swirling, and starts dancing.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadows under the lake
steps.content: Those wishes that have been wishful thinking... Those dreams that can never come true...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadows under the lake
steps.content: Those unresolvable pains... The cruelties... The realities...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadows under the lake
steps.content: Dance, Hamel, dance... Use your dancing... to make our dreams a reality...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadows under the lake
steps.content: Thank you, we love you...
Hamel closes her eyes, losing herself in her last dance, impermeable to time and space.
Everyone needs a home. His home is where his friends are, whereas a Dancer's home is forever the stage.
steps.female_content: Everyone needs a home. Her home is where her friends are, whereas a Dancer's home is forever the stage.

steps.content: But the spot where the shackles lie is warm. When she closes her eyes, all she sees is the pained face of the person who has been pushed out of the illusory realm.
He shouts to Hamel, but his voice is pushed back by currents and bubbles. What's he so hung up on? What's he... trying to say?
steps.female_content: She shouts to Hamel, but her voice is pushed back by currents and bubbles. What's she so hung up on? What's she... trying to say?

steps.content: I won't let it end. You still have a lot of time, a big world ahead of you! One day, I'll come back for you. Wait for me!
I'll give you a real stage, where you're going to dance for yourself, not for others. One day, I'll come back for you. Wait for me!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: What... did he say?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: If we meet again... I want to ask him.
steps.female_content: If we meet again... I want to ask her.
